name: Arabic
note: ⚠️ The Arabic corpora below are DOWNLOADED but the code that processed them is GONE. It lived in the sibling repo's tools/content/zipf/ar_zipf/, which was deleted in the 2026-07-27 blank-canvas reset; only the archives and a 15 MB lemma_cache.json survive, in an unignored directory totalling 3.2 GB. Arabic also needs a decision the German pipeline never faced: inherited dialect and written MSA are separate systems and must be measured separately, so 'Arabic frequency' is at least two lists.
